# PM actual adapter: SOURCE CANDIDATE — DO NOT MERGE

This excluded source unit adds a concrete native reader, private pre-init guard,
persistent SSH broker and selected rsync guardian. It does not qualify a target,
grant execution authority, or replace Publisher/00F selection and production GO.
No target, SSH, WP bootstrap, native write or deployment was used to develop it.
Local fixtures use temporary files/processes and explicit native boundary doubles.

## Immutable runtime and existing primitives

The forward image remains the complete 31-path PM 2.7.2 image of
989de9b1654b4501916f4ab61eb6b484859bfa25. Prior/recovery remains the complete
27-path 2.5.11 image of 2ca89ffdfc65ff59a3727c1f1510bad6710d2708 /
686d8317b6d46f370be008bde1d20abcfe22f3a0, including Git modes. References and
the 33598b07 state-bound core remain unchanged. `deploy.py`, `remote-guard.py`,
packaging and their legacy entry points remain unchanged.

The new entry calls existing immutable archive packaging, selected-main checks,
remote identity/preflight and the existing activation/readback/cache-flush/Kinsta
purge/version sequence. It preserves the full original effect receipt instead of
fabricating the old core's exact `{effects: ...}` projection. Its successor
transition parser requires every existing identity flag, literal version, effects,
complete bytes/modes and native continuity before recording completion.

The optional `--rsync-path` guardian **is a new transport delta**. Existing
`-az --delete -e`, exclusions, payload and destination retain their meaning; that
does not confer historical transport qualification on the guardian.

A recovery dispatch requires an independently selected actual release tree whose
filtered payload is the exact 27-path recovery image **and** carries these reviewed
excluded controls. A forward tree cannot claim to be a recovery release. A partial
image whose entry/bootstrap is unqualified is refused, retained and reconciled;
there is no automatic downgrade or entry repair.

## Reader and native classification

`pm-native-before-reader.php` imports without I/O, hooks or provider registration
and returns one closure. Callers compile the exact captured/hash-checked bytes.
The private CLI form accepts `(request, observationStream)` with schema
`hp_pm_actual_native_reader_observation_v1`; its closed keys are:

- schema, root, site, environment, context, projection, productIds, phaseFile;
- startup, allowedOptionCallbacks, allowedErpCallbacks.

The site/root are fixed to production holisticpeople.com; IDs are exactly
43395, 43406 and 43457. Context is early-mu, pre-init or full-native; projection is
startup or code-before. Startup has the exact reviewed constants Core 3.4.24,
Inventory schema 0.22.0 and PM migration `yes`. No candidate Inventory lease-table
schema/API is required or installed.

`allowedOptionCallbacks` is a map by context, each value mapping every selected
tag to an ordered list of source fingerprints. ERP pins map the three selected
ERP tags to ordered fingerprint lists. Each fingerprint has priority:int,
acceptedArgs:int, callback:string, file:string|null, startLine:int|false,
endLine:int|false and sourceSHA256:string|null. These are reviewed **source
invocation scope**, not expected product rows or a caller's success flag.
Unknown callbacks/source differences refuse before dispatch.

The reader checks raw singleton rows against actual cached/getter values. It
projects only the known twelve Inventory startup events, enforcing the native
empty-argument key `md5(serialize([]))`, recurrence and one matching event.
Unrelated global cron is not a continuity hash. It reads source values/pointers
and SKU for the three products, with no order/customer/stock/ledger field scan.
Any row in **every** selected product's PM journal namespace, source-boundary
option, ingredient lease, categorization lease or semantic lease refuses CODE
before FIELD. A completed/partial/inflight/unknown FIELD journal cannot become
admissible by matching an arbitrarily prepared snapshot.

Owner cron/Action Scheduler projection uses the actual 069/077 job shapes:
ingredient `[id,generation]`, category `[id]`, semantic `[product|media,id]`,
ingredient recovery `[]|[afterId]`, category sweep `[afterId]` and semantic sweep
`[afterId,semantic]`. All owner sweeps are retained. Unknown shape, malformed
cron or an over-bound owner queue refuses. Absent AS table produces null actions,
which remains distinct from observed zero actions. These observations do not
establish worker completion, quiescence or FIELD materialization safety.

Only full-native requires actual WP_CLI, user 7474 and all selected capabilities,
then reflects and evaluates actual ERP admission. Early code context never
claims that actor or loaded-plugin ERP facts. The internal startup readback is
`STARTUP_CONDITIONS_OBSERVED`; only the complete CODE-before read can derive
`PRE_FIELD_CLEAR`. All frames have executionAuthority=false.

## Shared MU/CLI factory interface (candidate contract)

The same closure accepts `(request, phaseHandle, context)` for an independently
reviewed trusted caller. Request keys are exactly operation, slug, action,
contentRoot, siteOrigin, source and nativeScope. The action is the caller's
semantic action after its selected-specific wire has been authenticated.

`nativeScope` is closed:

```
schema: hp_pm_three_source_observation_scope_v1
productIds: [43395,43406,43457]
optionCallbackSourcePins: {context: {tag: [fingerprint, ...], ...}, ...}
erpCallbackSourcePins: {tag: [fingerprint, ...], ...}
```

The observation handle is exactly stream, path, inode, device, ownerPID and
readerPID. Context is exactly entry (mu_early|cli_code), actor
(os_owned_code_token), wordpressActorAssumed (false). PIDs are checked against
the actual process/direct parent; metadata alone is not mutex ownership proof.
The reader never acquires, closes or unlocks the borrowed observation stream.
The independently reviewed guard/broker retains a **separate private exclusive
owner description** and proves that ownership in its call path and causal tests.

Success envelope is closed: contract=hp_pm_three_source_observation, version=1,
context=mu_early|cli_code, state=COMPLETE, disposition=PRE_FIELD_CLEAR, projection.
COMPLETE means a complete read. Disposition is derived from the real native
journal/boundary/lease facts. Failure throws; the caller retains the original
private error and treats it as unavailable/unknown, never a matching placeholder.
Early projection includes codeActor with wordpressActorAssumed=false; only the
full projection has actor7474/ERP facts. No `selected.nativeBefore` enters this
callable. The trusted caller release must pin this exact independently reviewed
reader body; arbitrary selected file/hash pairs do not establish trust.

## Pre-init guard

The private unique-attempt `wp --require` loader requires the actual supported
WP_CLI `add_wp_hook` API and direct parent PID. It installs before regular plugins.
It checks each actual option getter unchanged, with the guard last at PHP_INT_MAX.
It rejects raw/cache drift, missing/wrong Inventory startup cron or callback
order changes. This is neither callback removal nor an option replacement.
The cron getter check avoids dependence on a possibly absent final cron-event
filter or a missing-event early return. No repair, scheduling, DDL, cache reset,
provider/business method or general SQL sandbox is supplied.

The guard retains a durable private startup readback before proceeding. The full
observer runs separately after normal bootstrap. Exact target WP option/cron,
WP_Hook, WP_CLI loader and startup timing remain qualification requirements;
local models and source version strings do not prove those APIs.

## Broker, copy guardian and UNKNOWN

The broker authenticates the existing opaque owner, exact selected.json bytes,
private token hash/expiry, immutable operation/attempt/phase and INFLIGHT state.
It requires a fresh empty private attempt and writes an exclusive durable
reservation before native calls. Re-entry into an existing attempt is refused.
It does not mint tokens, rewrite selections, transition/release owner state,
install MU/readers, repair directories or clean a failed attempt.

Native children receive only an independently opened observation FD. Timeout
cancellation addresses only the created isolated child session. The broker's
private owner FD is CLOEXEC. The trusted copy guardian is a distinct ownership
participant: Linux SO_PEERCRED, actual /proc executable/cmdline/starttime and a
pidfd bind its process to the exact immutable operation/attempt/config. A durable
transfer intent and receiver acknowledgement precede server spawn. SCM_RIGHTS
transfers the same owner open-file description to that guardian; **the rsync
server child receives no owner descriptor**. The guardian never LOCK_UNs it and
retains it until its exact server child has exited, including cancellation.
Literal server return and actual guardian exit are required before effects.

Guardian/broker loss can leave a live server and late writes. Persistent
INFLIGHT/UNKNOWN must block every accepted new mutation/recovery/cleanup until
its actual owned writer lifetime, partial maps and retained receipts are
reconciled. No SSH/client timeout permits retry, owner release or token reissue.
The accepted-mutator roster and ambient-worker FIELD STOP are separate owner
qualification; this PM source cannot fence old cached MU or ordinary workers.

Raw command stdout/stderr are spooled privately from spawn and fsynced before
classification. Original exception/partial streams are recorded before cleanup;
cleanup failures remain separate. Byte-valued filenames are lossless base64.
Oversized output refuses parsing while retaining both complete original files
and the literal process result. Existing attempts/intent files are never reused.
Immediate completed-repeat reuses the SAME persistent broker after transition.
Standalone completed-repeat retains the SAME immutable operation/attempt and
reservation; a fresh observationId creates only attempt/observations/<id> read
evidence. That mode allows only native/observe/preflight, never copy/effects.
Original intent/completion and target record bytes remain unchanged. A new local
evidenceDirectory alone does not grant a new target mutation attempt.

## Validation and remaining qualification

New local tests cover getter/cron faults, native source classification, real PHP
observation-FD isolation, real SCM_RIGHTS transfer, subprocess failures/timeouts,
raw-capture counterexamples and guardian cancellation. The Linux broker fixture
executes actual AF_UNIX/peer/proc/pidfd/guardian code with a temporary fake server;
it is explicitly skipped on unsupported hosts and must run on new-head Linux CI.
It includes guardian loss, combined owner loss, late writes and absent receipts.
These are disconnected source tests, not actual target receipts.

Still required before any execution selection: independent frozen-source review;
new-head CI; compatible accepted-kit reader/phase/wire source pins; exact current
WP/CLI/option/cron/loader APIs and finite Core/Inventory/MU/drop-in sources;
actual raw/cached/policy/job/callback facts; actual phase adoption by each accepted
mutator; exact guardian/server executable and serialized argv; private-root and
process/FD transport qualification; source promotion/image identity and served
PHP proof. FIELD worker/materialization admission and human/browser acceptance
remain separately owned. The pre-existing NO_GO is unchanged.
